# curves.concepts: IPolarCurve2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A plane curve expressed in polar form about the origin: the position at angle
> theta is (RadiusAt(theta) \* cos(theta), RadiusAt(theta) \* sin(theta)).
> The canonical \[0,1\] parameter maps to one full turn unless documented otherwise
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polar\_coordinate\_system).

## Signature

```plato
interface IPolarCurve2D
    inherits ICurve2D
```
